newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rise ahead of new tax.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rise ahead of new tax.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.23 percent on Friday as small investors sought to beat a new 25-percent tax on securities' profits that will extend to individuals from January, market participants said.
"Some people decided to do their business now in order to avoid the tax next year and that could push prices up another one or two percent before the end of the year," one broker said.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 2.66 points to 1,184.6.
* Overall six shares rose, 11 fell, two remained unchanged and six were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek "A" issue was by far the most active share, falling 0.50 percent to 19,840 tolars on volume of 112.5 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
